description: Angular component class for configuring generator actions in the Thingsboard rule node UI, including form setup, script testing, and validation.

classes.name: GeneratorConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring generator node actions, managing form state, script validation, and testing.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for generator configuration.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates validators for script fields based on selected script language.

methods.name: prepareInputConfig
methods.description: Prepares configuration data for input, normalizing nulls and defaults.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares configuration data for output, extracting originator details.

methods.name: testScript
methods.description: Tests the script using NodeScriptTestService and updates form with the result.

methods.name: onValidate
methods.description: Performs validation, especially for JavaScript scripts.
